observations: Photo 0 shows two tall white standing air conditioners wrapped in plastic, with two outdoor units stacked behind them, all branded 'Panasonic'.
The outdoor units are stacked vertically, each with a circular fan grille and 'Panasonic' logo visible.
The indoor units are tall, rectangular, with horizontal vents at the top and bottom, and a central control panel with a small display and buttons.
Photo 1 shows a closer view of the two indoor units, with the Panasonic logo visible on the control panel.
The units appear to be in used condition, with some plastic wrap still on, but no visible damage in the photos.
The setting appears to be an outdoor market or roadside display, with cars and people in the background.

claims.claim: Imported & neatly used Original panasonic 2hp standing air conditioners
claims.evidence: The brand 'Panasonic' is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, but the '2hp' capacity is not visible on any label or display. The 'imported' and 'neatly used' claims cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: The units may not be 2hp as claimed, or may be non-functional or damaged internally.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label or rating plate on the indoor or outdoor unit, showing the exact model and cooling capacity (in BTU or HP).
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower capacity or non-working

risks.risk: The units may have internal damage, wear, or refrigerant leaks not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running, with the fan spinning and cool air blowing, and a close-up of the control panel displaying operational status.

risks.risk: The units may be counterfeit or rebranded, despite the visible Panasonic logo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model number and serial number on the indoor and outdoor units, cross-referenced with official Panasonic documentation.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model and rating plate on both indoor and outdoor units, showing the exact model and cooling capacity.
Video of the unit running, showing fan operation and cool air output.
Close-up of the serial number and any certification labels.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed as Panasonic, but the 2hp claim and condition cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks include incorrect capacity, non-functionality, or counterfeit units. Proof is needed to confirm model, capacity, and working condition before pricing.
